faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MAHE Project Technical Support – III recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is September 21, 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated email address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the essential qualifications for the Project Technical Support – III post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc/M.Tech/B.E in Computer Science, Information and Communication Technology, Data Science, Electronics, or Biomedical Engineering. UGC-CSIR/NET/GATE qualification is preferred.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify an age limit. Candidates are advised to refer to the detailed notification for any age-related information.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support – III position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of INR 28000 plus 10% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q5. How should candidates apply for this position?
faq.answer: Applications should be submitted via email to [email protected] with a detailed CV and cover letter.

faq.question: Q6. What is the nature of this job?
faq.answer: This is a project-based research position at Manipal Academy of Higher Education.

faq.question: Q7. Are there any desirable skills mentioned for the role?
faq.answer: Yes, desirable skills include proficiency in Python (NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn), time-series and signal processing, machine learning with interpretability methods, and Git-based reproducible workflows.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Technical Support – III position.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be informed via email about the interview date.

faq.question: Q10. Where is MAHE located?
faq.answer: Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE) is located in Manipal, Karnataka, with the pincode 576104.
